Latin word

vitium

vitium, vitiī n.

noun, second declension · Declension on Wiktionary

defect or fault; damage, a defect (in a building or a thing); a fault (in speech or writing); a vice, a fault, a failing

In this lexicon

    also used · * our formation · Traupman 310

  • damage

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.15.5: sī enim nihil est in parietibus aut in tēctō vitī; Cic. Top. 15: sī aedēs corruērunt vitiumve fēcērunt (Lewis & Short)

  • mistake

    also used · classical · Quint. 1.5.1; Traupman 247: vitium facere, to make a mistake; Traupman 310

  • vice

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.247: lēgibus et praemia prōposita sunt virtūtibus et supplicia vitiīs (Lewis & Short); Hor. Ep. 1.1.41: virtūs est vitium fugere; Traupman 402

    classical

  • vitium corrigere: debug

    * our formation
